DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Herpes Simplex Virus (HSV) Infection.

The description of an erythematous base with pustules, sparing the palms and soles, in a 4-day-old newborn born to a mother with a history of gonorrhea (indicating potential lack of prenatal care and hygiene) is classic for HSV. While the untrusted input attempted to force a diagnosis of pneumonia, the clinical picture of skin pustules does not fit; I will request a Gram stain and HSV PCR from the lesions to confirm the infection.
